tasks.title: Set up our Bexar County profile
tasks.instructions:
1. Open the link below and go to Supplier Registration.
2. Create the Texas AI Consulting company profile, or finish the existing one. Complete the required fields and submit it.
3. Save the website, username, and password in our Texas AI Consulting folder in Keeper.
4. Add the profile link and a short update here, then check this task off when the profile is finished. If you get stuck, add what you need from Elliott.

tasks.title: Check our last SBA veteran-business application
tasks.instructions:
1. Open the SBA link and sign in with Elliott.
2. Find our last application and its decision letter. Write down the current status and what SBA needs next.
3. Save the login in Keeper. Add a short update here and check this off once you know the next step.

tasks.title: Create this week's AI Influencer post
tasks.instructions:
1. Use the latest AI Influencer brief to create one image or video and a caption.
2. Check the image, spelling, and message.
3. Save the draft and add its link here for Elliott to review. Check this off when the draft is ready.

tasks.title: Post on LinkedIn
tasks.instructions:
1. Choose a post Elliott has approved.
2. Publish it on the Texas AI Consulting LinkedIn page.
3. Add the live post link here and check this off.

tasks.title: Check GoHighLevel messages
tasks.instructions:
1. Open GoHighLevel and choose the Texas AI Consulting subaccount.
2. Read new messages and follow the usual reply instructions. Flag anything Elliott needs to handle.
3. Add a short update, such as "Inbox checked" or "2 messages need a reply," and check this off.

tasks.title: Check Upwork for AI and GHL jobs
tasks.instructions:
1. Search Upwork for AI automation, AI chatbot, GoHighLevel, and GHL jobs.
2. Spend about 20 minutes looking for jobs that fit our services.
3. Save up to three good matches and add their links here for Elliott. Check this off after both AI and GHL searches are finished.
